decision.observation: The goose stands mid-path below the closed gate; latch hardware is on the right post with a silver rod at ~(0.655,0.32) and a tap with brown pot below (~0.69,0.55). Tutorial persists.
decision.hypothesis: Grab is a toggle: beaking the latch makes sparkles (grab), but my follow-up 'walk-away' used a left-button press with the cursor over the post, which doesn't register as ground. Recipe: stand at post, right-click latch, then click open ground behind.
decision.memory: Cursor position matters: left-click must land on walkable ground to move the goose.
